other_conditions: The Gram Panchayat must be the basic administrative unit.
Village population must be 3000‑5000 in plain areas or 1000‑3000 in hilly, tribal or difficult areas (approximate sizes may be accepted).
Lok Sabha MPs must select a Gram Panchayat within their own constituency; Rajya Sabha MPs may select any rural Gram Panchayat in the state from which they were elected.
The selected Gram Panchayat cannot be the MP’s own village or that of his/her spouse.
If the MP’s constituency is urban (no Gram Panchayat), they must choose a Gram Panchayat from a nearby rural constituency.
Each MP must initially adopt one Gram Panchayat immediately and two more later, aiming to develop three Adarsh Grams by March 2019 and additional five by 2024.
benefits_summary: Integrated development of selected villages covering infrastructure, human, economic, environmental, social welfare and good governance initiatives.
